desc: This is a snapshot of the Orders and Observations Incubator Implementation Guide to support community review and testing.
title: OO Incubator Implementation Guide
registry-description: The Orders and Observations Incubator Implementation Guide provides a consolidated workspace for emerging FHIR resources, profiles, operations, vocabularies, and other artifacts developed by the HL7 Orders and Observations Work Group. The content is actively evolving and supports trial use, pilot implementations, and community review.
introduction: This implementation guide is the incubator for emerging Orders and Observations content, including FHIR resources, profiles, operations, vocabularies, and other implementation artifacts.
